Thursday, February 1, 2024 at 8:11 AM

@everyone 


....Transmission incoming from Token Riot......
,
Mission Alert for Cornucopias: Operation Impound Freedom

Brief: 5 GTI Javelin vehicles have been impounded by the enemy. As a team, your efforts can drive the enemy out and the vehicles can be released by YOU, our Revolutionaries.

Objective: Interact with Token Riot by listing/buying/selling ANY NFT on Token Riot Marketplace. 
Duration: 7 day window - Start: 2/6 12am UTC End 2/13 12am UTC
Goal: Release all 5 vehicles from the impound.
Mechanics: Accumulate as much RP as possible through interacting with Token Riot Marketplace. 
List of actions that earn user Riot Points:
Sign up: 500 RP
,
Setup Profile: 500 RP
,
Unique listing: 100 RP / listing
,
First ever listing: 500 RP bonus
,
First ever sale: 500 RP bonus
,
First ever buy: 500 RP bonus
,
NFT Purchase: Buyer awarded 1:1 RP to sale price
,
NFT Purchase: Seller awarded 50% of what buyer receives
,

Outcome: The top 5 participants with the most RP from listing/buying/selling after 7 days will be awarded a GTI Javelin (see below).

Prepare your assets. The countdown begins at 11pm UTC TODAY. Let's reclaim what's ours and cement our place in the history of the revolution.

Leaderboard Rewards:
1st - Cornucopias GTI Javelin | Mythic
2nd - Cornucopias GTI Javelin | Legendary
3rd - Cornucopias GTI Javelin | Rare
4th - Cornucopias GTI Javelin | Uncommon
5th - Cornucopias GTI Javelin | Common
6th - 300 RP
7th - 250 RP
8th - 200 RP
9th - 150 RP
10th - Remaining participants - 100 RP

Please provide feedback on your experience in our #testing-feedback channel on the Token Riot Discord Server: https://discord.gg/Tv44RpxVzk

Token Riot: https://tokenriot.io/ (edited)
Tuesday, February 6, 2024 at 8:33 AM

@everyone

Staking Reward Timeline Update:
,
GREAT NEWS!!!
In discussions with DripDropz I have learned that they will begin making rewards claimable in epoch 468 which is

Monday Feb. 19th at 21: 44: 51 UTC.
,
This is two epochs (10 days) earlier than I had understood previously. So, you can begin claiming your rewards on the 19th. This will begin with the rewards for staked land assets during epoch 450. Then carry on releasing rewards for claiming one epoch at a time.

If you need assistance in how to claim, please use the command !dripdropz to show the instructions.  

NOTE: 
Rewards stack for 8 epochs, so you can wait and claim them later if you wish.  If you fail to claim them within the 8 epoch stacking time period, they will begin to roll off one epoch at a time.

The Staking Reward announcement above means that the staking deck will need to be edited...
This graphic will be edited to reflect the two epoch earlier beginning.

ALERT
,
Since our announcement of Base as the ETH L2 of choice for our Node sale, many are asking about Base and may not have heard of them.
Base has no Network Token that is used for settlement like other L2's. 

There are scammers offering or sending fake Base Tokens. 
PLEASE BE CAREFUL!

read more:https://help.coinbase.com/en/coinbase/other-topics/other/base

@everyone


USDC on BASE
,
At the time of creating our node deck, we were still uncertain of which chain we would be using for the ETH sale. With our decision to utilize BASE, there is no option for USDT as payment. The official payment option will be in USDC. 

Further instructions on how to mint and use BASE are coming! If you are unsure on how to use BASE and/or the Ethereum blockchain, please do not rush. Wait for our instructions. 

Thank you.

@everyone 


Announcement of ETH Tier 2 File Node Sale
,
Tomorrow Feb 13 @ 20:00 UTC the sale will open up at nft.cornucopias.io.
,
Instructions and a video tutorial are being finalized and will be provided today.

@everyone

We have just received word from one of our advisors that one of their wallets was compromised resulting in a large amount of COPI tokens being taken. The stolen tokens were immediately sold and we are taking steps to freeze the funds.

Rest assured this is not a Cornucopias treasury or team member as we take full measures to protect those assets with multisig and more.  We can assure you that this is an isolated event and we are quickly addressing the issue. This is a yet again another reminder to always navigate the crypto space with security at the top of your mind.

Thank you!

@everyone

Miracles do happen... we were able to resolve the issue shortly after my last message. We have successfully tested and minted the first node on Base!


Sale will begin 22:15 (less than 10 minutes)
,
PLEASE DO NOT RUSH. Take your time and enjoy your minting on Base.
